Want it written for you? The Personal plan.

Some evenings don’t fit a book. Tell us about your kid and the one moment that keeps going wrong, and we write your plan: the crew member behind it, one small move for each evening and the exact words for your kid’s age.

  • A short form about your kidAge, the moment, when it happens, what you’ve tried, what a good week would look like. About 10 minutes. No child’s name, no medical details.
  • Your plan, written by a personThe crew member behind the moment, one small move for each evening and the exact words, for your routine and your week.
  • By email within 3 working daysFrom hello@littlebraincrew.com. Questions once you have it? Reply to that email.
  • For parents who want it done for themAlready have the Toolkit or the Reset? Say so in the form and the plan builds on what you know.

Start my Personal plan · $199

You fill in the form first, then pay on Creem’s secure checkout. Educational guidance about habits and words, not medical advice. If something about your child’s health worries you, call your pediatrician first.

Questions before you start

How do I get it?

You’ll get an email with your link right after you pay. Read it on your phone, tablet or computer, and print the tracker. Nothing to install.

How much time does it take?

Tonight: one page of the Toolkit for the moment you’re in, about ten minutes. Then the 30-day plan: about 10 minutes a day, one small habit at a time; miss a day and you pick up where you left off.

Is it a subscription?

No. Everything we sell is one payment, and it’s yours to keep. Nothing renews.

What if it’s not working for my family?

Try the 30-day plan in your Toolkit for seven evenings. If it’s not working, email us your hardest moment and we’ll send you a personal plan, included with the Toolkit. Want it written for your family from day one? The Personal plan ($199).

Can I get a refund?

You get instant access to digital content, so all sales are final (see our Terms). Toolkit buyers can still ask for personal help after seven evenings. If a link or file won’t open, email us and we’ll fix it.

Is this medical advice?

No. It’s learning for parents, built on everyday habits. We don’t diagnose, treat or promise results. If something worries you, call your pediatrician first.

Not sure? Start with the Toolkit.

Everything, for $19, tonight. If you later want it written for your family, the Personal plan builds on what you already have.
